phase3_findings.description: `sbl_says` re-introduces `2>/dev/null` on its `sbl_run` invocation, so a helper crash (unhandled exception, argparse usage error, missing interpreter) produces no stdout, `grep -q` fails, and `sbl_says` returns `no`. `sbl_denies` inverts that `no` into `yes` — the expected value of the assertion `#1618/#1897 skill-body: the twice-recorded root is not refused by the error arm`. That assertion therefore passes green against a helper that never ran. It is the same inversion hazard iteration 1's F-6 closed on the fixture-build channel (`FIXTURE_BUILD_FAILED`), reopened on the helper-crash channel. Remedy: drop the `2>/dev/null` from `sbl_says` and gate on `sbl_run`'s exit status before the grep, printing a distinct non-yes/no token (e.g. `HELPER_FAILED`) that `sbl_denies`' pass-through arm carries.

The diff-added `sbl_run` comment ("Do not discard stderr here: callers capture stdout alone, so a helper traceback would vanish and a crash would read as a bare NO_VERDICT") reads as a run-wide guarantee that `sbl_says` does not honour. The prose half of FI-1. Filed by comment-analyzer as a Critical `documented_falsehood`.
phase3_findings.truthfulness_sweep_result: NOT promoted — the sweep promotes only on demonstrated falsity. The comment's prohibition is scoped by the word `here` (inside `sbl_run`) and its stated rationale (`callers capture stdout alone`) is true of `sbl`, `sbl_rel` and the inline sites; it asserts no universal about every caller's redirection. Independently, the Phase 4.1.5 behavior-inert prose cap covers this surface on the same evidence recorded for FI-3, so it is capped at Suggestion either way and is outside the Phase 4.2 carve-out.

phase3_findings.description: The diff-added comment at lib/test/run.sh:25244-25245 reads "The no-following-body reason names the DIRECTORY that was compared, not the SKILL.md path its own sentence claims to name." Against HEAD the helper's sentence is `...no following body record naming its own directory (%r)...` interpolating `root_dir_for(path)` — it claims to name the directory and does. The trailing clause describes the pre-fix state this same diff removed, so it is false against HEAD.
phase3_findings.truthfulness_sweep_result: PROMOTED as a demonstrated falsehood, then routed to the Phase 4.1.5 behavior-inert prose cap, which covers it — so it is NOT a Phase 4.2 self-contradicting-diff carve-out finding and carries no carve-out marker.

Suggested one-pass qualifier at all three sites.

phase3_findings.description: The relocated empty-operand guard in `dirs_match` (the F-10 fix: test emptiness BEFORE `normpath`) has no regression backstop. The analyzer demonstrated the discriminating mutation: with the guard restored to its pre-diff position, `dirs_match("", ".")` returns True, and `.` is exactly what `root_dir_for()` returns for a bare-filename `--root`, so the fail-open is reachable from production code. `sbl_dirs_match_both_modules` is called three times and every call passes a non-empty absolute directory against a hardcoded `skills/review` comparand, so reverting the fix leaves the suite green. Cheapest remedy: give the helper a second parameter for the comparand and assert `"False False"` for an empty base dir against `.`.

The `mid is None` arm of the `delivered-whole` reason — added by this diff as the F-13 fix — has no fixture. Every positive fixture points `--root` at a real `skills/**/SKILL.md`, all of which yield a non-None `mid`, so both the `else` string and the `mid is not None and` short-circuit above it are dark. Dropping the conditional and restoring the unconditional "and a distinctive interior line" wording would reinstate the exact overclaim this PR fixes with no test going RED. A fixture whose `--root` is a scratch file of short lines, asserting the reason carries `only the tail was checked`, closes it.

`raf_body = open(raf_path…) if scen.startswith("contains_name_") else ""` couples fixture correctness to a scenario-name prefix: a future scenario using `raf_body` silently receives an empty body unless its name carries that prefix, for the saving of one small file read per build. The comment beside it states a rationale rather than a wrong change prevented, which is the shape the prevention-only comment standard excludes. Fails closed if tripped (an empty body reads short-delivery), hence Suggestion.

The committed fixture header preserves the scrub caveat's "Treat this artifact as sensitive" (correctly — the helper's leading-comment tolerance is under test) while the surrounding provenance block never states that the three retained records were inspected and carry no credential. A reader cannot tell whether the sensitivity label still applies to what survived the extraction. One sentence in the header resolves it.
phase3_findings.truthfulness_sweep_result: NOT promoted — the finding is an omission (the header does not state that the records were checked), not a claim demonstrably false against HEAD. The sweep never promotes on suspicion.
